AC_ARG_ENABLE([libmount-mountfd-support],
  AS_HELP_STRING([--disable-libmount-mountfd-support], [do not use new mount API based on FDs]),
  [], [enable_libmount_mountfd_support=check]
)
UL_BUILD_INIT([libmount_mountfd_support])
UL_REQUIRES_BUILD([libmount_mountfd_support], [libmount])
UL_REQUIRES_LINUX([libmount_mountfd_support])
UL_REQUIRES_HAVE([libmount_mountfd_support], [mountfd_api], [mount FDs based API])
UL_REQUIRES_HAVE([libmount_mountfd_support], [linux_mount_h], [linux/mount.h])
AS_IF([test "x$build_libmount_mountfd_support" = xyes ], [
  AC_DEFINE([USE_LIBMOUNT_MOUNTFD_SUPPORT], [1], [Enable support for new mount FD based kernel API])

CONFOPTS += --disable-makeinstall-chown
ifeq ($(DEB_HOST_ARCH_OS),linux)
CONFOPTS += --with-selinux
CONFOPTS += --with-smack
CONFOPTS += --enable-partx

ifneq ($(filter stage1,$(DEB_BUILD_PROFILES)),)
	CONFOPTS += --without-systemd --without-udev --without-audit
	CONFOPTS += --disable-newgrp --disable-login --disable-nologin
else
	CONFOPTS += --with-systemd --with-udev --with-audit
	CONFOPTS += --enable-newgrp --enable-login --enable-nologin
endif

ifneq ($(filter pkg.util-linux.noverity,$(DEB_BUILD_PROFILES)),)
	CONFOPTS += --without-cryptsetup
else
	CONFOPTS += --with-cryptsetup=dlopen
endif
endif

# As a result of CVE-2024-28085, we no longer install mesg/write.
CONFOPTS += --disable-mesg
CONFOPTS += --disable-write

# build static versions of programs used in fdisk-udeb and util-linux-udeb
CONFOPTS += --enable-static-programs=fdisk,sfdisk,blkid

# Help welcome packaging the (libmount) python bindings.
# See http://bugs.debian.org/811361
CONFOPTS += --without-python

debian/man-getopt-examples.patch
debian/verbose-tests.patch
debian/hardlink-tests-known-failed.patch
debian/lsfd-usrbin.patch
debian/sensible-pager.patch
debian/login-support-LOG_OK_LOGINS.patch
debian/login-do-not-print-motd-done-by-PAM.patch
debian/login-turn-off-btmp-utmp-lastlog-writing.patch
debian/salsa-ci-skip-tests.patch
upstream/loopdev-use-openat2-RESOLVE_NO_SYMLINKS-for-backing-file.patch
upstream/libmount-restrict-source-path-canonicalization-for-non-ro.patch

assessment.vendor_status: Debian tracker still labels installed Trixie2.41.5 vulnerable; upstream GHSA affected>=2.42 and patched2.41.6/2.42.3. Preserve vendor status rather than rewriting it from analysis.
assessment.source_feature_result: Exact Debian hook_subdir.c lacks Linux>=6.15 detached-tree fastpath and never assigns api->subdir. Restricted mount path calls mnt_context_target_fd_required; hook_mount_pre291-295 returns -ENOTSUP whenever true; exact context.c406-409 returns mnt_context_is_restricted. Thus specific restricted-user bypass described by GHSA is not implemented in inspected Debian source.
assessment.comparison: Upstreamv2.42 hook_subdir.c331-343 adds Linux>=6.15 detached-tree branch and api->subdir assignment before nonroot refusal; absent in Debian2.41.5 source. Existing Debian open_tree at201-202 operates after attaching temporary tree and follows restricted-mode rejection; its presence alone does not establish this CVE path.
assessment.debian_patches: Exact series lists11 patches. No hook_subdir/hook_mount detached fastpath addition listed; source-path-canonicalization patch edits context.c and mount manual, not Linux6.15 detached subdir feature.
assessment.build_configuration: Debian rules do not disable libmount mountfd support. configure.ac1380-1390 auto-enables mountfd API when Linux headers/syscalls support it. Absence conclusion concerns newer restricted detached-subdir branch, not absence of all mountfd support. Exact build config.h/compiler output not collected; cannot claim compiled all features disabled.
assessment.recommended_classification: Keep conservative known_API_trigger_not_used based on actual-image imports/absent frontend. Add source_feature_not_present_for_upstream_described_restricted_path as corroboration and explicit vendor/source discrepancy. Do not label library absent, package fixed or scanner record eliminated.
remaining_limits: No exact Debian binary disassembly/build config or buildinfo linkage performed here; source audit is not binary reproducibility proof.
Debian tracker may intentionally track a broader root-mode issue or have source-range metadata debt; request clarification before overriding vendor status.
Existing mount operations as root could still involve other libmount bugs; this source result does not clear CVE76642/78410.
Direct ELF import inventory does not exclude arbitrary FFI/dlsym consumers; actual root evidence should qualify scope of known callers.
